description: Browse every credited artist, albums and playlists in lists or five-column grids, with circular artist images, live artwork and native music playback.
features: Independent Artists, Albums and Playlists list/five-column grid settings
Circular artist artwork in grids, lists and details
Collaborations appear under every credited artist
Browse artists, then their albums, then songs
Square album artwork beside its tracks
Artist-image live thumbnails with Ken Burns slideshows and album-art fallback
Requires Eclipse host version 2 or later
